title: Magnifying Glass
subject: English
summary: “Magnifying Glass” is a chapter that highlights the importance of curiosity, observation and scientific thinking. It explains how a magnifying glass helps us see tiny objects and details that are difficult to notice with our normal eyes. By using it, we can observe insects, leaves, flowers and many other small things more clearly. It encourages students to explore their surroundings and discover the hidden wonders of nature. The chapter teaches us that curiosity and careful observation help us learn new things and understand the world around us.
